cover_headline: H-1B Workers Taking Microsoft Buyout Face 60-Day Deadline to Stay

end.headline: H-1B Workers Taking Microsoft Buyout Face 60-Day Deadline to Stay
end.line: Workers who accept are expected to leave on December 31 — and the 60-day clock runs from when employment ends, not from the December decision deadline.

facts: Microsoft's Voluntary Exit Offer is open to about 60,000 employees at level 70 and below in the United States, Canada, India and the United Kingdom
Microsoft has not said whether H-1B holders are eligible, or whether it will offer immigration-related assistance
USCIS gives workers up to 60 days after employment ends to find a new sponsor, change status, or depart

quote.speaker: Amy Coleman
quote.text: This offer gives eligible employees who may be considering a future outside the company a new choice to make that transition now with support.
